## Functions

### checkBackendConstruction()

```ts
function checkBackendConstruction<FacetClass>(
  ctx,
  loader,
  artifact,
  limits,
  priorStateSchema,
): Promise<void>;
```

The Instance owns the disposable facet and supplies its already-read prior state
schema. Only initialized App storage is copied; supervisor state and authority
are never copied. A unique Loader ID isolates candidate globals. No invocation
frame or guestEnv factory is accepted.

### createCloudflareAppInstance()

```ts
function createCloudflareAppInstance<FacetClass, Host>(
  ctx,
  loader,
  resolve,
  guestEnv,
  bootUi,
  limits?,
  onAbort?,
): AppInstance<Host>;
```

Run an App Instance inside a SQLite-backed Durable Object on workerd, celld or
Cloudflare. Supervisor state lives in the Durable Object's own SQLite; the App
backend runs in a named `app` facet loaded through the Worker Loader, so its
database survives Release replacement and stays separate from the supervisor.
Guest code gets only host gatekeeper bindings and no ambient outbound access.

#### Type Parameters

| `Host`         |
